//: Emit-only config for `build:server`. Type-checking is done separately by `npm run typecheck` using the root tsconfig (moduleResolution: bundler, needed to resolve @modelcontextprotocol/sdk's exports-map-only types). This config emits CommonJS for server/dist (the CLI spawns `node server/dist/index.js`) and keeps the inherited bundler resolution (TypeScript 7 removed node10 and accepts bundler with module commonjs); --noCheck keeps emit independent of type errors.
